ai_summary: Advanced Enzyme Technologies Ltd. reported its daily share buyback activity on September 08, 2026, repurchasing 36,543 equity shares at an average price of approximately ₹299.50. This action brings the total shares bought back under the program to 1,096,528 as of that date, signaling a strategic effort to return capital to shareholders and potentially enhance earnings per share through a reduced share count. As a routine regulatory filing, this document presents no immediate red flags concerning the company's ongoing buyback program.
